title: Validation returns 422 where requirement example cites 400
evidence: main.rs:38-44 returns UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY (422) for blank title/author; REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify example says 400. 422 is semantically correct for validation and documented in README.md:30, so this is not a defect.
suggestion: No change needed; 422 is the appropriate code for a well-formed request that fails semantic validation.
